ongoing.name: Davao City Bypass Construction Project
ongoing.description: 45.5-kilometer project connecting Toril to Panabo City with the Philippines' first long-distance mountain tunnel.

ongoing.name: Samal Island–Davao City Connector (SIDC) Bridge
ongoing.description: 3.98-kilometer, four-lane extradosed bridge project linking Davao City and Samal.

ongoing.name: Davao Public Transport Modernization Project (DPTMP) / HPBS
ongoing.description: Establishing a modern bus-based public transport system with a 672-kilometer network and 1,100 buses (electric and Euro-V diesel). Partial operations expected in 2026.

ongoing.name: Davao International Airport Modernization
ongoing.description: Upgrades to the airport including passenger terminal building expansion.

ongoing.name: Davao City Coastal Road
ongoing.description: 17.8-kilometer bypass road designed to decongest city proper, act as storm-surge barrier, and serve as public promenade. Segments A, B, C are operational/near completion.

ongoing.name: Waste-to-Energy (WTE) Plant
ongoing.description: Proposed facility in Tugbok District designed to process 600 tons of solid waste daily, generating 11 MW of electricity. Estimated cost ₱5B-₱7B.
